values.note: recreation.gov books 7 standard sites (back-in; maximum vehicle length 20, 20, 24, 24, 31, 36, 36 ft) and 3 tent-only sites; the other sites are not reservable online. A 23-ft rig fits 5 of the 7 bookable RV sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232399 ('Van Hook Glade offers 18 secluded sites') + RIDB catalog facility 232399 (7 reservable 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' with 'Max Vehicle Length' 20-36, Back-in; 3 'TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC'; 12 'MANAGEMENT' not reservable), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232399 ('Hot showers and flush toilets are also provided, and firewood is available for purchase on-site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run by FIND Outdoors (the Cradle of Forestry in America Interpretive Association); hosts on site. Reservations on recreation.gov close 4 days before arrival; holiday weekends need 3 nights. Two vehicles and two tents per site; 8 people.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232399 (facility_rules reservationCutOff 4, minHolidayWeekendStay 3; notices 'This campground is managed by the Cradle of Forestry In America Interpretive Association', 'Campground hosts on-site', 'Limit two vehicles and two tents maximum') + FS page ('This is a fee campground operated by FIND Outdoors', 'Maximum Occupancy per site: 8 persons / 2 cars / 2 tents or 1 RV & 1 tent'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Nantahala NF (Nantahala Ranger District) on US-64 in the Cullasaja Gorge, 4.5 miles west of Highlands at about 4,100 ft; shady, wooded sites. A sharp curve inside the loop makes maneuvering an RV difficult. A short trail leads to Cliffside Lake (swimming, trout fishing, no boating). --Claude
summary: Open in 2026 (FS 'Site Open'; recreation.gov calendar shows bookings through October); no Helene or US-64 alert. Confirmed $24 (FS page + 2026/2027 rate table), no hookups, 18 sites, flush toilets/hot showers, reservable on recreation.gov. Added season Apr 1 - Oct 31, max 36 ft (bookable RV sites 20-36 ft, all back-in), 4-day booking cutoff, 3-night holiday minimum, concessionaire FIND Outdoors. Not stated: fcfs for the 8 sites recreation.gov doesn't book, max stay, drinking water. Note: the 'larger sites take ~24-26 ft' line was wrong against the catalog (24, 31 and 36 ft) and was dropped.
